latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-browser: browser automation CLI for AI agents.

- Enables website interaction: navigation, form filling, button clicks, screenshots, data extraction, testing, and automation.
- Provides a command-based workflow: open URL, snapshot elements, interact via element refs, and re-snapshot after changes.
- Supports command chaining for efficient, persistent browser sessions.
- Offers multiple authentication/session handling modes (import browser auth, persistent profile, session name, vault, state files).
- Includes essential commands for navigation, interaction, waiting, download management, device/viewport emulation, capture (screenshots/PDF), clipboard, and diffing page states.
